## Public-preview checklist

- [ ] No datasets, traces, certificates, private URLs, credentials, or raw personal
      media
- [ ] Public API/manifest changes are documented and agreed
- [ ] Performance claims include device, browser, content, and build conditions
- [ ] Third-party attribution and user-visible documentation are updated when needed
